title: compile_to_evm returns runtime bytecode
rationale: The runtime header uses SHR, and the assembler emits it.
logos_source:
Contract C
State
  record { x : Int = 0 }
Clauses
  Clause A(): Effect
    Provided That
      x == 0
    Shall
      Set { field: "x", value: 1 }
End

title: Unknown names are diagnostics
rationale: An unknown predicate must not become PUSH 0.
logos_source:
Contract C
State
  record { x : Int = 0 }
Clauses
  Clause A(): Effect
    Provided That
      not_a_name == 1
    Shall
      Set { field: "x", value: 1 }
End
note: An unknown predicate name is a compile error.

title: Escrow happy path
rationale: Deposit, time condition, release, token balances and state. Deposit syntax is Escrow, which the parser does not build, so this stays blocked even after SHR until Escrow exists.
logos_source:
Contract WorkForHire_M1
  Parties
    client : Party = 0xC1e0000000000000000000000000000000000000
  Definitions
    let price : Decimal = 10
  State
    record { submitted : Bool = false, accepted : Bool = false }
  Clauses
    Clause SubmitWork(): Effect
      Provided That
        submitted == false
      Shall
        All [
          Set { field: "submitted", value: true },
          Emit { event: "Submitted", data: {} }
        ]
  Term
    until now + Duration("90d")
  GoverningLaw
    "New York, USA"
  Signatures
    require client signed
End
note: Deposit, time condition, release, token balances and state. Deposit syntax is Escrow, which the parser does not build, so this stays blocked even after SHR until Escrow exists.

title: Premature release reverts
rationale: now = deadline - 1 reverts and changes nothing when the guard is >=.
logos_source:
Contract C
State
  record { start_ts : Int = 1700000000 }
Clauses
  Clause Release(): Effect
    Provided That
      now >= start_ts + Duration("7d")
    Shall
      Set { field: "start_ts", value: 1 }
End
note: now = deadline - 1 reverts and changes nothing when the guard is >=.

title: Exact deadline succeeds for >=
rationale: now = deadline succeeds when the rule is >=. The comparison pushes the deadline first so LT sees now on top.

rationale: A second release does not transfer again.

    Shall

End

title: Three selectors dispatch
rationale: Each selector reaches its body. An unknown selector reverts. KF-EVM-DISPATCH.
logos_source:
Contract C
State
  record { x : Int = 0 }
Clauses
  Clause One(): Effect
    Provided That
      x == 0
    Shall
      Set { field: "x", value: 1 }
  Clause Two(to: Address): Effect
    Provided That
      x == 1
    Shall
      Set { field: "x", value: 2 }
  Clause Three(amount: Int): Effect
    Provided That
      x == 2
    Shall
      Set { field: "x", value: 3 }
End
note: Each selector reaches its body. An unknown selector reverts. KF-EVM-DISPATCH.

title: ERC-20 false return reverts
rationale: A token that returns false rolls the transaction back.
logos_source:
Contract C
  Parties
    client : Party = 0xC1e0000000000000000000000000000000000000
  State
    record { x : Int = 0 }
  Clauses
    Clause Pay(to: Address, amount: Int): Effect
      Provided That
        x == 0
      Shall
        Transfer { asset: 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48, from: client, to: to, amount: amount }
End
note: A token that returns false rolls the transaction back.
